name: Recurring count, mention and public-counter markets (tweet-count ladders, "what will X say" strikes, box-office / chart / leaderboard counters)
one_line: Model repeating public counters (Elon post counts, mention strikes, box office, LMArena rank) and rest NO in the over-priced 10-50c band; the live keyword-sniping leg is worth a few hundred dollars per strike.
maturity: Emerging; tweet ladders are an Established market ($6.6-9.7M/week) whose published calibration edge has reversed in an eight-ladder own sample (10-20c buckets win 19-21%) and whose volume fell 5-7x since February; mention strikes show a real YES overpricing in two 40-event own samples (always-NO +5-10% per $ risked, in-sample); no transcript-bot PnL exists; culture counters have volume but no PnL evidence
requires_ai: optional; LLM builds speaker-by-term base rates and compiles rules offline; counting is arithmetic
edge: Retail prices ladders flat and buys YES on words; NO side in the 10-50c band earns it
capital: $1k-$10k; depth of $0.1-3k per strike or bucket binds before capital
build_time: 2-3 weeks solo on an existing quoting stack; +1-2 weeks for a live ASR leg
opportunity_size: Tweet family $6.6-9.7M/week (shrinking), mentions ~$2M/month plus rare spikes; NO rent low tens of $k/month for all
expected_results: Axios wallet $160k realised on 982 mention strikes (80.3% profitable, full 2,078-position record), dormant since Aug 2025; own always-NO +5-10%/$ risked in-sample; guess $90-390/month at $5k
competition: 1,649 takers per ladder, LP bots, dashboards; 6-13 wallets per live strike
flag: none for public counting; prohibited for scripted-speech insiders (CFTC Perez)
validate: 90-day replay of mention strikes by price bin, out-of-sample NO rule ≥8c/share net; $500 maker pilot
top_risk: Thin depth, decayed tweet edge, one missed 80c strike wipes many wins
solo_fit_reason: Cheap to build and test with dozens of independent draws a month, maker-side with rebates and no disputes in the sample; but capacity is a few hundred dollars per strike, the tweet ladder's published edge has reversed and volume is falling, so it is a $100-500/month overlay on a quoting stack rather than a standalone business.
speed_class: execution-sensitive: modelling edges settle over days; the live strike leg reprices in 1-8 s but pays hundreds of dollars
results_1k: marginal; -$10 to +$70/month (derived from halved in-sample NO rent)
min_capital: ~$3k; hosting and one 85c bucket loss exceed a small month
capacity_ceiling: ~$15-25k solo; $200/strike and $1-3k per Elon bucket at the touch
services: The Numbers / Hits Daily Double / arena.ai pages

open_doubts: Both calibration samples are one month and in-sample; the mention overpricing curve was measured on the same events it would be traded on, and the always-NO total swings from +11.5 to +24.9 shares between two 40-event windows.

Mid-week tweet-bucket calibration could not be measured cleanly because Polymarket closes passed buckets early and prices-history stops at the close; the two oldest ladders have no price history at all.
No transcript or ASR bot PnL was found; the live-leg capacity figures rest on four strike tapes.
Culture-counter (box office, music, LMArena) PnL is unverified; the AI-wallet accuracy figures come from Polymarket's newsletter without dollar totals.
The Data API v2 user-stats `trades` vs `trade_count` fields are undocumented; fill counts here use `trade_count`.
The Tweet Quant article's 7.4% vs 13.7% gap could not be re-derived for its own 86-week window; only the Aug-Sep 2026 reversal is own data.
